summary: Guest Send was capped at 10 per IP in a fixed clock hour, and refused tries counted too: a family, a party or a carrier IP behind one address was blocked up to an hour while the message said 'Give it a minute'.
fix: 30 Sends per IP in a sliding hour (5-minute buckets), and a refused try gives its count back; per-invite and per-address caps still bound abuse. Same message.
